{{Quote|We weren't even on the Perlemian; sometimes the beacon at Uthtara would break down and you wouldn't see a tradeship for weeks until it got fixed.|Baragwin sense lattice imprinted by a Republic soldier|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Uthtara''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] astronomical object located in the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]]. During the [[Tionese War]], it was the site of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace jump-beacon]] that facilitated commercial [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] travel to the celestial body [[Okator VIII]]. At some point during the conflict, [[Warship/Legends|warships]] affiliated with the Republic's enemy, the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]], [[Attack on Uthtara|attacked]] Uthtara, damaging the jump-beacon.

==Description==
Uthtara was an astronomical object<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Uthtara system/Legends|Uthtara system]], a part of the [[Eucer sector/Legends|Eucer sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Tionese War]],<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which broke out in [[24,000 BBY]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]],<ref name="EGTW" /> Uthtara was the site of an<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]]<ref name="EGTW" /> Republic [[Hyperspace beacon/Legends|hyperspace jump-beacon]], which enabled [[tradeship]]s traveling along<ref name="Author's Cut" /> the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] to visit [[the Divide]] celestial body [[Okator VIII]]. Occasionally, the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump-beacon would malfunction, leaving the [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] unable to visit Okator VIII for [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] until the structure was repaired.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> At some point in the conflict, a group of [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] raider [[Warship/Legends|warships]] [[Attack on Uthtara|attacked]] Uthtara, damaging the jump-beacon in the process.<ref name="EGTW" />

Following the war's end<ref name="Author's Cut" /> around [[23,900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|Republic soldier]] imprinted into a [[Baragwin sense lattice]] an audio-visual account of a Tionese [[Attack on Okator VIII|attack]] on Okator VIII, which the [[Republic soldier|soldier]] survived in their youth. In the record, the [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] noted the reliance of the celestial body on the beacon at Uthtara for [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] commerce.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Also, the caption mentioning Uthtara is a private memorial of sorts. I created Uthtara as part of a first-person remembrance of a Tionese attack on a Republic frontier world. I had to cut the vignette but left the new planet name behind.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Tumblr">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/20907109370/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-2|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 2}}</ref>}}
Uthtara was created by [[Jason Fry]]<ref name="Tumblr" /> for the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. In the book, an attack on Uthtara was illustrated by [[John Van Fleet]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In his personal blog, Fry noted that Uthtara was intended to be a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and that its mention in ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' served a "private memorial" in that it was the sole remaining reference to a vignette cut from the book before its release.<ref name="Tumblr" />

In [[2014]], however, the vignette mentioning Uthtara was released as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" /> The StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Uthtara [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square R-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
